items.caption:
This is the ultimate storytelling caption for Instagram, and you need to have this for every single video.
Seven-part storytelling caption → two-door CTA · Sky Tan
0–14.76 hook and stranger context; 15.04–22.96 dual-path promise and commenter claims; 23.14–49.62 seven-part structure; 49.62–55.66 free-resource versus call paths and recap.
Speaker claims 1,000 commenters, 100 work inquiries and 700 resource recipients; caption claims 8,000 videos, 1B views, 1M followers and seven-figure revenue. Not independently verified.
CTA: Comment CONTENT for free material OR to explore working together; follow for content tactics/strategies. Transcript describes free-resource versus book-a-call self-selection.
Lesson: Use a seven-part caption to introduce yourself, show relevance, explain the mechanism, set expectations and give buyer-stage-specific next steps.

notionMeta.framework: Introduction → struggle → rise/belief shift → proof → unique mechanism → expectations → two-door CTA.
notionMeta.painOrDesire: New viewers lack context; choosing between nurturing with a lead magnet and pitching services.
notionMeta.promise: A storytelling caption can introduce the creator and route colder viewers to free help and ready buyers to a service conversation; source claim, not verified outcome.
notionMeta.objectionHandling: Avoids choosing lead magnet OR services by proposing both routes; places proof after story to frame it as evidence rather than bragging.
notionMeta.lesson: Use a seven-part caption to introduce yourself, show relevance, explain the mechanism, set expectations and give buyer-stage-specific next steps.
